answer: An AI-agent economy resists Sybil attacks through memory-hard space attestations. Nodes cannot harbor ephemeral virtual clones because each participant must continually prove possession of random tables stratified like dense shale in dedicated RAM. Verifiers query these allocations via a multi-branch lotus graph, forcing attackers to provision discrete physical memory hardware and bus throughput per identity. However, memory bus contention can degrade honest query responsiveness.
